description: Offline Quran with 10 Qira'at, Hadith, prayer times, adhan, azkar & qibla. Aya is a comprehensive, offline-first Islamic companion app built with Flutter. It provides everything a Muslim needs for daily worship in one elegant, ad-free interface. Prayer Times & Adhan • 14 calculation methods with offline fallback — no internet required • Native adhan playback with 8 reciters (Mishary, Abdul Basit, Madinah, and more) • Per-prayer adhan toggle with fajr-specific reciter • Pre-adhan reminders (5/10/15/20 min before) with vibrate/voice/both modes • Flip-to-silence and volume-key stop gestures Quran Reader • 10 Qira'at supported — Hafs, Warsh, Qaloon, Shu'bah, Duri, Susi, Bazzi, Qunbul, Hisham, Ibn Dhakwan • 12 reciters with per-ayah timestamp sync — bundled offline • 6 tafsir editions — Al-Muyassar, Al-Jalalayn, Al-Qurtubi, Ibn Abbas, Al-Waseet, Al-Baghawi • Continuous mushaf mode or ayah-by-ayah reading • Auto-bookmarking and full-text Arabic/English verse search Hadith • 13 collections — Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi, Nasai, Ibn Majah, Malik, and more • Arabic & English with grading badges (Sahih, Hasan, Da'if) • FTS5 full-text search across all books • Hadith explanation (Sharh) and grading (Takhreej) Azkar & Supplications • 11 categories — Morning, Evening, Post-Prayer, Daily Duas, 99 Names of Allah, and more • 60+ authentic adhkar with Arabic, transliteration, translation, and references • Digital Tasbih counter with custom presets Additional Features • Prayer Tracker with daily/monthly/yearly views and statistics • Qibla Compass with Kaaba alignment detection • 8 home screen widgets — Prayer Times, Verse of the Day, Dhikr, Hadith, Tasbih, Hijri Date, Next Prayer, Asma ul Husna • Audio download manager for offline Quran listening • 6 theme presets — Dark, Light, Sepia, OLED Black, Adaptive Dark and Light • Full Arabic and English interface with RTL/LTR support • 100% offline-first — Quran, Hadith, Azkar, Prayer Times, and Adhan all work without internet Open Source Aya is free, open-source software with no ads. Licensed under MIT.
